info.title: KAC Platform API
info.summary: Calendar, imports, work profile and weekly schedule planning API.
info.description:
Versioned JSON API for the KAC calendar application.

All business endpoints live under `/api/v1`. Request and response examples use the seeded development account unless configured otherwise.
Mutating operations validate user input and calendar constraints on the server. Import operations are staged and do not write calendar events until confirmation.

The API contract is generated from Fastify JSON Schemas and is exported as `apps/api/openapi/openapi.json` for the Docusaurus reference.

fields.description: Błędy przy polach. Klucz to nazwa pola albo pozycja listy, np. "availability.0". Kody: required – puste pole; negative – wartość ujemna; must_be_positive – zero; out_of_range – poza dopuszczalnym zakresem; not_whole_number – minuty muszą być liczbą całkowitą; min_greater_than_max – minimum większe niż maksimum; target_below_min / target_above_max – cel (po przeliczeniu na tydzień) poza limitami; shorter_than_minimum – maksymalna długość zmiany krótsza niż minimalna; end_before_start – koniec nie jest po początku; duplicate_id – powtórzony identyfikator.

post.description: Creates a deterministic draft. Weekly class series are expanded into the selected week; work is planned only in availability minus mandatory classes and commute buffers. If no classes occur in the week, confirmation is required. If free time cannot cover the target, the result contains insufficient_free_time. Published planner shifts are excluded from the planning baseline so a replacement can reduce the previous hours.
